meta.title: A negative price is refused
gaps: the plan has the buyer send POST /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}}/create_bid_products, but the buyer's web-console session may not call POST /v1/bids/:id/create_bid_products (bids#create_bid_trade_products is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The library case submits price -5 rather than the requested price -100.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Please enter a valid price”, and never with a server error.
